ourVision.title: Our Vision
ourVision.description1: FreeDevUtils is built with a simple yet powerful vision: to give students and developers around the world access to a comprehensive collection of essential everyday tools that are fast, secure, and completely frictionless — empowering people globally and contributing to society, both directly and indirectly.
ourVision.description2: We believe that standard development utilities shouldn't be locked behind paywalls, require unnecessary accounts, or secretly harvest your data. This project is a testament to building reliable, client-side software that respects the user's privacy and workflow.

corePrinciples.title: Core Principles
corePrinciples.description: The foundational pillars that guide the development and operation of Free Developer Utilities.

points.1: No hidden fees, paywalls, or premium tiers.
points.2: Zero rate limits on any of our features or tools.
points.3: No sign-up or account creation required.

privacySecurity.title: Privacy & Security First
privacySecurity.description: Your data is yours. We do not want it.

points.0: Zero backend services; everything runs entirely in your browser.
points.2: We do not collect or store any user data.
points.3: Whatever you import or process stays strictly on your machine.

transparentCompliant.title: Transparent & Compliant
transparentCompliant.description: Open infrastructure with respect to global standards.

points.1: Minimal tracking: We only use Google Analytics to count overall visitor numbers to decide on future development.
points.2: Strictly utilizes legal and authorized open-source libraries.
points.3: Committed to abiding by all legal and open-source regulations.

summary.paragraph1: I am a senior software developer with over 11 years of experience in building scalable server-side applications, RESTful services, and modern cloud-native solutions.
summary.paragraph2: My technical foundation is rooted in Java and Spring (Spring Boot, JAX-RS) alongside robust data persistence strategies (JPA/Hibernate, JDBC). I have extensive experience working with big data tooling such as Apache Spark and Databricks, and deploying applications across major cloud platforms including Microsoft Azure and AWS.
summary.paragraph3: A significant focus of my career has been integrating complex Single Sign-On (SSO) and Identity Management solutions (Keycloak, Azure AD, PingFederate, Okta, RHBK). I have successfully delivered solutions across diverse domains—including healthcare, storage, insurance, and e-governance—leveraging both relational and NoSQL databases like MS SQL, MySQL, Oracle, and MongoDB.
summary.paragraph4: Angular and Angular Material have been part of my life for several years, as hobby project together we had several failed attempts to build a successful application. At the end I decided to use that energy to build something which will be useful to next generations and society directly or indirectly. As a non-profit venture these tools will be available for everyone to use.
